Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <3a7c671e...@news.mad.ttd.net>,
Geb <1gan...@teleline.es> wrote:
>Hello all

Hello!

>did the combat tap a vampire?,

Combat does not affect a vampire's tapped or untapped status. Only blocking,
taking actions, and specific card text taps a vampire.

>if i make a bum rush that isn't intercepted with an untapped vampire is him
>tapped after combat? or it remains untapped?

It remains untapped.

>another one about combat; if the opposit minion plays a blood of acid
>can i skin my strike or i have to strike with hands?

I'm not sure what 'skinning your strike' means, but you must choose a
strike at the appropriate point in the combat. If you have no other strike
available that you want to use, you must strike with hands, yes. Note that
Skin of Steel will not prevent Blood of Acid's damage, but Skin of Rock
(and other Fortitude cards that do not specify 'damage from a strike') will
work fine.

gomi
